paras: Chioninia spinalis is a species of skink in the family Scincidae. It is endemic to the Cape Verde Islands, and has been found on the islands of Sal, Boa Vista, Maio, Santiago, Fogo and several smaller islets.
Chioninia spinalis boavistensis Miralles, Vasconcelos, Perera, Harris & Carranza, 2010
